comment: WHICH SOURCE this plugin acquires its Entwurf runtime from, and it is committed on purpose (#116 M3-b3): an environment variable or a caller flag would let the acquisition authority be chosen by whoever happens to be running, and a fallback would turn an unreachable source into 'install something else'. The `npm` branch (name+version+integrity) is the active production authority, re-pinned to the published 0.34.1 with the registry's measured sha512 (#135); `herdr-checkout` remains the candidate-verification path and switching source still requires an explicit deactivate/activate, never inheritance.
name: @junghanacs/entwurf
